::: {#hero-heading}
I am a data scientist at the European Central Bank and a Max Weber Fellow at the EUI, using computational social science to study democratic backsliding in Europe.

My current research applies machine learning to classify illiberalism in political texts. Previously, I used experiments and quasi-experiments to evaluate the impact of policies across Europe.

I am always open to discussing possible collaborations. You can reach me at: [elena.cossu@live.it](mailto:elena.cossu@live.it).
:::
